evidence:
RUNTIME HALF. Every fact test.sh and its restart helper need is stated to the agent: path /app and entry `node /app/server.js` (instruction.md:15; integration.md:5); port 3000 with PORT honoured (instruction.md:15; integration.md:5 '0.0.0.0'); storage /app/app.db honouring DB_PATH (instruction.md:15; integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:208-209); health GET /api/health that 'never touches the database' (instruction.md:15; integration.md:9-10); seed /assets/seed_data.json loaded once, no shipped database, /assets and /instructions unavailable at runtime so copy into /app (instruction.md:15-17; hireops_rules.md:212-217); accounts with roles and shared password Hireops!2026 (instruction.md:19; hireops_rules.md:11); the exact env -i set PATH/HOME/NODE_PATH/PORT/DB_PATH, locked-down user, writable copy and cwd-independence (hireops_rules.md:206-210), matching test.sh `setsid env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT DB_PATH setpriv --reuid=65534 node $APP_ENTRY`; symlink rule (integration.md:16-19) matching test.sh's refusal of symlinks outside /app/node_modules; restart durability without reseeding (instruction.md:17; integration.md:8-9). Preinstalled deps, no npm install (instruction.md:15; Dockerfile installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1). Fixed clock: N-A - no criterion depends on wall-clock values (grading uses order and newest-first only; seed timestamps are July 2026; golden uses real new Date()), so no clock fact is needed. Network is public: CDN use allowed in the brief, and every judge URL is local (grep finds only http://localhost:3000 in prompts/app_context and 127.0.0.1 in test.sh) - Colderwater lesson 13 clean.
DELIVERABLE HALF. I mapped all 56 criteria (2 gates, 44 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual) to public text: job opening fields, places whole 1-50, manager from hiring-manager accounts (rules:28-30); add candidate at bottom of Applied, email validity, case-insensitive per-job dedupe, error at the field with input kept, other job allowed, account link (rules:32-37); one-stage moves, skips refused, reason required, Hired not rejectable, reopen only to rejected-from stage clearing reason, ordinary non-drag controls (rules:48-53; instruction:3); bottom arrival and shared persistent manual order (rules:57-60); Interview places, free re-order, freed place usable at once (rules:64-66); manager late-stage rights incl. re-order, reject from Interview/Offer, reopen only those, everything else refused; observer/candidate move nothing (rules:70-74); 409 naming who (rules:78-82; instruction:3); immediate move, put back, reason, focus on that card's controls (rules:86-88); multi-move board order, any stages, places counted for the set, all-or-none (rules:92-95); undo restores stage, place and reason, blocked by move/re-order/reject/reopen of those cards or overfill, notes don't count, once only, superseded by a later move (rules:99-104); notes by role and note draft kept 'for me on that browser' (rules:108-110); Activity per action incl. each undo and re-order, who and what, rejection reason, newest first, per-job filter, refusals leave no line, observer reads it (rules:18,114-118); live updates within 15 s incl. moves, new cards, unread, messages, seen marks, preserving typing, focus, open card, open conversation and scroll (rules:122-128; instruction:5); plain-text non-blank messages with line breaks, Enter/Shift+Enter, box empty and focused, failed send kept and explained (rules:144-146); newest 30, scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time, remaining count, anchor stays (rules:150-153); per-person unread, total, open-at-newest counts as read, scrolled-up notice with count (rules:157-166); seen rules incl. hiring manager, observer never counts (rules:170-172); drafts per conversation across view switch and reload, ended session prompts at next server action, nothing sent, private per user on that browser, cleared on send (rules:176-181; instruction:7); candidate list with title, team, wording table, own conversations, nothing leaked in anything the browser receives incl. streams, 404 for others' applications (rules:24,185-202; instruction:9); 401/403 statuses (rules:22-23); observer read-only (rules:19); restart persistence (instruction:17). Seed-derived expected values recompute from seed_data.json (Lena APP-301: 3 messages, read_count 2, last by staff -> 1 unread; Platform Engineer Applied Greta/Ade/Marco and Screen Priya/Samuel; Noor's note text; Noor PE Infrastructure/Interviewing, PD Design/Application received; Tomas DA Finance Systems/In review; 120-message conversation). Visual rows grade desktop craft only, matching instruction.md:11 ('A clear desktop workspace is what matters... We don't need theme switching or a special phone layout') and visual prompt.md:14.
COUNTERFACTUALS. Broken app that could pass because of this row: none found - every graded promise is public, so the row gives no free credit. Conforming alternatives that could fail, each judged covered (Note-level, not defects): (1) an app holding its session only in memory would fail the gate leg 'Reload the page: you are still signed in' (constraints judge.toml hro_gate_shared and the gate paragraph of functional/polish/visual prompts). Not verbatim, but the brief separates reload from sign-out (instruction.md:7 'when I look at another one, reload, or get signed out'; rules:59-60 'after a reload, a fresh sign-in or a restart'; rules:177-178) and requires a server-issued session (rules:11-12), so surviving reload is the only reasonable reading. (2) hro_add_candidate: 'The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details' - an app omitting source from card details fails; supported by rules:32 (added with name, email and source) and rules:108 ('Opening a card shows its details'). (3) Undoing a rejection or a reopening (hro_reject_reason, hro_reopen) relies on those being moves; supported by their placement under 'Moving a card' (rules:46-53) and 'Who may move what' (rules:70-73) and by 'gives back a rejection reason the move removed' (rules:100-101). Lessons file applied: lesson 1 (no hidden demands) checked across all 56 criteria - none hidden; lesson 13 clean; lesson 18 (unstated save-transport) - live transport is explicitly free (rules:128) and the failed-send row allows request abort or offline, no transport assumption. Lessons 12/14/15/16 bear on rows 1/32/35/28, not this row. Raw evidence index hashes verified; this is a source-coverage row, so no runtime measurement is required to decide it and none is claimed (no Oracle, model or portal score).
